newsitem.title: USA: MMS seeks interest in Beaufort Sea oil lease sale.
newsitem.headline: MMS seeks interest in Beaufort Sea oil lease sale.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service issued a notice Monday seeking interest and comments on an oil and natural gas lease sale which it proposed to hold in the Beaufort Sea off Alaska in April 1998.
"This is the beginning of the extensive and thorough decision-making process of whether or not there will be a lease sale in the area," said MMS Director Cynthia Quarterman.
The area proposed for a sale covers about 1.7 million acres, extending from about three miles to 25 miles offshore, in water depths of 25 to 120 feet.
The agency said it was seeking comments on geologic, environmental, biological, archaelogical, social and economic conditions which could affect potential leasing and development in the area.
